posts.name: offalimb
posts.cooked: What are the (if any) post OblivAeon  Kickstarter release plans?  Will the mini-expansions and alternate hero cards be available separately afterwords, or is this pretty the only time you will be able to get them?  I'm just trying to get a feel for the future of Sentinels.  I'm assuming, that while this is the last expansion, the game will remain in print for a while.  So what of people who either lack the funds to Kickstart right now, or come to game late?   Will there be any way to get this content later?

posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked: Everything except the foil cards and canvas prints will be available post kickstarter. The OblivAeon promos (Ivana, Dark Watch Harpy etc) will not be available, outside of the all hero promo cards pack, but the mini expansions such as Stuntman and Benchmark should be.

posts.name: Animus
posts.cooked:
pwatson1974:

Everything except the foil cards and canvas prints will be available post kickstarter. The OblivAeon promos (Ivana, Dark Watch Harpy etc) will not be available, outside of the all hero promo cards pack, but the mini expansions such as Stuntman and Benchmark should be.

From the KS page: " However, we want to make this a special thing for just this year, so we're only going to make enough to cover this Kickstarter plus a few hundred extras to sell at Gen Con and to retailers." So they will be available at Gen Con and some retailers may have a few, but that's it.
